name: listbox
title: Listbox
description: An always-open list to choose from: one or several with Shift ranges, grouped options with descriptions, typeahead and an optional search.
docs: options are { value, label, description, icon, disabled, group }; options with the same group are shown together under one sticky heading. The list is one tab stop and keeps the focus on itself (or on the search field when searchable), pointing at the active option with aria-activedescendant. Arrow keys move, Home and End go to the ends, typing jumps to the next option that starts with it, Enter and Space choose. With selectionMode="multiple", Space toggles, Shift with the arrows or a click chooses the range from the anchor, Control or Command with A chooses every option (from the search field only while it is empty), and a live line reads "N selected". searchable adds a search field above the list: every word typed must be in the label or the description, ignoring case and accents, the matches are marked, the arrow keys and Enter work from inside the field and Escape clears it. Pressing an option never moves the focus into the field: with a mouse the field keeps the focus if it has it, and otherwise (always on a touch screen) the list takes it, so a tap does not raise the on-screen keyboard. height is the tallest the list grows before it scrolls inside its box. name sends the chosen values with a plain form.
